from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, os, subprocess, time
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]; out=root/'build/compiler-v3'
node='/nix/store/5a8ysg1jnj8jmzzyfcfw7rvpvnp5rfpa-nodejs-24.15.0/bin/node'
report={'status':'running','note':'Correctness/capability checks, not repeated timing benchmarks. Chibi remains the build host.','steps':[],'artifacts':{}}
def run(name,command,env=None):
 started=time.monotonic(); result=subprocess.run(list(map(str,command)),cwd=root,env={**os.environ,**(env or {})},capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=600)
 (out/(name+'.stdout')).write_text(result.stdout);(out/(name+'.stderr')).write_text(result.stderr)
 report['steps'].append({'name':name,'command':list(map(str,command)),'seconds':time.monotonic()-started,'status':result.returncode,'stdout':result.stdout,'stderr':result.stderr})
 print(name, result.returncode, round(report['steps'][-1]['seconds'],3),flush=True)
 assert result.returncode==0,result.stderr
 return result

def save():
 (out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')

def build(name,module,target):
 run(name,['cargo','build','--offline','--release','-p','snail-runner','--target',target],{'SNAIL_LLVM_IR':str(module),'CARGO_TARGET_DIR':str(out/'cargo')})
 suffix='.wasm' if target=='wasm32-wasip1' else ''
 src=out/'cargo'/target/'release'/('snail-runner'+suffix);dst=out/(name+suffix);dst.write_bytes(src.read_bytes());dst.chmod(0o755)
 return dst

try:
 core=out/'core.scm';core.write_text('(import (snail-scheme core))\n(display (+ 19 23))\n(newline)\n')
 run('emit-compiler',[root/'snail-compile',root/'src/snail-scheme/compile.scm',out/'compiler.ll'])
 native=build('compiler-native',out/'compiler.ll','i686-unknown-linux-musl')
 wasm=build('compiler-wasm',out/'compiler.ll','wasm32-wasip1')
 run('host-core',[root/'snail-compile',core,out/'host-core.ll'])
 run('native-core',[native,root,core,out/'native-core.ll'],{'SNAIL_RUNTIME_STATS':'1'})
 run('wasm-core',[node,'--no-warnings',root/'scripts/run-wasi.mjs',wasm,root,core,out/'wasm-core.ll'],{'SNAIL_RUNTIME_STATS':'1'})
 assert (out/'host-core.ll').read_bytes()==(out/'native-core.ll').read_bytes()==(out/'wasm-core.ll').read_bytes()
 run('host-fibonacci',[root/'snail-compile',root/'examples/fibonacci.scm',out/'host-fibonacci.ll'])
 run('native-fibonacci',[native,root,root/'examples/fibonacci.scm',out/'native-fibonacci.ll','--timing'],{'SNAIL_RUNTIME_STATS':'1'})
 assert (out/'host-fibonacci.ll').read_bytes()==(out/'native-fibonacci.ll').read_bytes()
 for name,target in [('native','i686-unknown-linux-musl'),('wasm','wasm32-wasip1')]:
  exe=build('fibonacci-'+name,out/'native-fibonacci.ll',target)
  command=[exe] if name=='native' else [node,'--no-warnings',root/'scripts/run-wasi.mjs',exe]
  result=run('run-fibonacci-'+name,command,{'SNAIL_RUNTIME_STATS':'1'})
  assert 'fib(25) = 75025' in result.stdout
 for path in out.iterdir():
  if path.is_file() and path.suffix not in ['.json','.stderr','.stdout']:
   report['artifacts'][str(path.relative_to(root))]=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 report['status']='passed'
finally: save()
